comment: generated by backend/scripts/audit_vectors.py; checked by backend/tests/test_audit_vectors.py; run with tools/audit_vectors.py - keys are random, the file is made once

cases.name: proof/valid
cases.why: record 4 of 7 is in the log signed by key A (hybrid)

cases.name: proof/valid-first-record
cases.why: the first record (leftmost leaf)

cases.name: proof/valid-last-record
cases.why: the last record of an odd-sized tree (a leaf promoted without a sibling)

cases.name: proof/valid-classic-key
cases.why: an Ed25519-only audit key (algorithm ed25519)

cases.name: proof/record-altered
cases.why: the record's content changed, its record_hash did not

cases.name: proof/record-rehashed
cases.why: the record changed and was re-hashed: it is no longer the leaf the signed root covers

cases.name: proof/path-altered
cases.why: one hash of the inclusion path changed

cases.name: proof/wrong-index
cases.why: the record placed at another position of the tree

cases.name: proof/signature-altered
cases.why: the checkpoint's Ed25519 signature changed

cases.name: proof/pq-signature-altered
cases.why: a hybrid key: Ed25519 still verifies but ML-DSA-65 does not - both are required

cases.name: proof/pq-signature-removed
cases.why: a hybrid key with its ML-DSA-65 signature removed (a downgrade)

cases.name: proof/pq-key-removed
cases.why: the ML-DSA-65 key removed to pass as Ed25519-only: the signed fingerprint names both keys

cases.name: proof/untrusted-key
cases.why: valid, but signed by key A while you trust only key B

cases.name: checkpoint/valid
cases.why: a checkpoint of 7 records signed by key A

cases.name: checkpoint/field-altered
cases.why: tree_size changed outside the signed statement

cases.name: checkpoint/statement-altered
cases.why: the statement and the field changed together: the signature no longer matches

cases.name: checkpoint/statement-not-canonical
cases.why: the same statement, not in canonical form (sorted keys, no spaces)

cases.name: timestamp/valid
cases.why: an RFC 3161 time-stamp of the statement by the test TSA

cases.name: timestamp/other-tsa
cases.why: the token does not chain to the TSA you trust

cases.name: timestamp/other-statement
cases.why: a valid token, but for another checkpoint's statement

cases.name: timestamp/missing
cases.why: a time-stamp is required (--tsa-ca) and there is none

cases.name: consistency/valid
cases.why: the log of 7 records extends the one of 3

cases.name: consistency/valid-pinned
cases.why: the older checkpoint is the one you saved earlier (--pinned)

cases.name: consistency/path-altered
cases.why: one hash of the consistency path changed

cases.name: consistency/history-rewritten
cases.why: record 2 was rewritten and everything after it re-hashed and re-signed with the real key: the new log no longer extends the checkpoint taken before

cases.name: consistency/not-the-pinned-one
cases.why: the server shows a rewritten older checkpoint too; yours (--pinned) has another root

cases.name: rotation/valid
cases.why: key A handed over to key B at 5 records (both signed the handover); B is confirmed independently

cases.name: rotation/new-key-not-confirmed
cases.why: a valid handover, but you have not confirmed key B's fingerprint yourself

cases.name: rotation/no-handover
cases.why: the newer checkpoint is signed by another key and nothing links the two

cases.name: rotation/old-key-did-not-consent
cases.why: the old key's signature on the handover does not verify

cases.name: rotation/fork
cases.why: key A was handed over twice (to B and to C): whoever held A signed a second successor

cases.name: rotation/handover-outside-range
cases.why: the handover is dated before the older checkpoint, so it cannot link the two

cases.name: rekor/valid
cases.why: a Rekor entry for this checkpoint's statement, signed by the publishing key, with a valid signed entry timestamp of the test log

cases.name: rekor/time-altered
cases.why: the log's time moved back a day: the signed entry timestamp no longer verifies

cases.name: rekor/index-altered
cases.why: the entry's index changed

cases.name: rekor/other-statement
cases.why: a valid entry, but for another checkpoint's statement

cases.name: rekor/signature-not-by-publishing-key
cases.why: the entry's signature over the statement is not the publishing key's

cases.name: rekor/other-publishing-key
cases.why: published, but with a key other than the one you pinned (--publishing-key)

cases.name: rekor/unknown-log
cases.why: an entry of a log whose key you did not give: not checked, so not enough when one is required

cases.name: rekor/missing
cases.why: a publication is required and the checkpoint has none

cases.name: sigstore/valid
cases.why: a real checkpoint of Provenza's own server (stickstock.lol), published in rekor.sigstore.dev; the log's key is the one Sigstore distributes, built into the verifier

cases.name: sigstore/time-altered
cases.why: the real entry with its time moved back a day

cases.name: sigstore/tree-size-altered
cases.why: the real checkpoint claiming one record more
